About
Cookies are small text files that can be used by websites to make a user's experience more efficient.

The law states that we can store cookies on your device if they are strictly necessary for the operation of this site. For all other types of cookies we need your permission.

This site uses different types of cookies. Some cookies are placed by third party services that appear on our pages.

You can at any time change or withdraw your consent from the Cookie Declaration on our website.

Learn more about who we are, how you can contact us and how we process personal data in our Privacy Policy.

Ideal Irrigation Solution

Sub Surface Drip Irrigation

Experience precision-engineered irrigation that cuts water use, maximizes nutrient delivery, and drives smarter growth. Subsurface systems create cleaner, weed-free surfaces and optimize root zone conditions with minimal salinity. Advanced design reduces disease pressure, system wear, and routine maintenance. With fully buried infrastructure, SDI offers unmatched reliability—secure, efficient, and built for the future.

Learn more

CleanLine® Double Protection

Double protection for clean pipelines

Metzer’s CleanLine irrigation pipelines provide dual protection against biofilm, combining an active ingredient and a smooth surface barrier to prevent buildup. This eco-friendly solution reduces chemical use, lowers maintenance, and ensures long-lasting performance in challenging water conditions.

Learn more

InbarRGX-Growbags precise irrigation

Clustered Drippers Control

Metzer’s InbarRGX solution brings precision and simplicity to greenhouse and growbag farming—delivering root-free, uniform irrigation with RootGuard® and clustered drippers. Easy setup and smart design drive higher yields, water savings, and hassle-free performance.

Learn more

RootGuard® Roots clogging prevention

Reliable Solution Against Root Intrusion

Metzer’s RootGuard Band® is a patented, field-proven solution for preventing roots intrusion in subsurface drip irrigation (SDI) systems
